---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

Describe the problem you're trying to solve, or the workflow that is currently awkward or missing.

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see. Be as specific as you can — screenshots, mockups, or links to similar features in other apps are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Additional context

Any other context that might help prioritize or shape the solution.
